newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul to list Korea Telecom by June - report.
newsitem.headline: Seoul to list Korea Telecom by June - report.

text.p: The Finance and Economy Ministry plans to list state-run Korea Telecom Co in the first half of this year, Yonhap Television News reported on Monday.
Ministry officials were not immediately available for comment.
The Yonhap report quoted unnamed ministry officials as saying finance minister Kang Kyong-shik confirmed that the company would be listed on the bourse as originally planned.
Brokers said the report renewed worries over a share oversupply on the market.
Korea Telecom, about 80 percent owned by the government, has a monopoly on the local telephone service and holds the lion's share of the long distance and data communications markets.
